biotools.summary: LimROTS is an R/Bioconductor package implementing a hybrid method for robust differential expression analysis in proteomics data, combining linear models and empirical Bayes methods. It’s designed to improve accuracy and reproducibility in complex omics data analysis, and the source code is available on GitHub.
